name: Hexagon Nutrition
description: Hexagon Nutrition Limited is a research-oriented nutrition company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of nutrition products. Supplier to global public health programmes
Revenue from premixes, clinical nutrition, preventive healthcare
